summary: Connect community needs to NGO proposals, budgets, workplans and monitoring outputs. Explore the five-day foundation course and enrol.
lede: Program design and implementation connects assessed community needs to feasible activities, budgets and monitoring plans. For NGO staff and partner practitioners, it involves assessing needs and stakeholders, building a theory of change and logical framework with measurable indicators, and preparing linked budgets, workplans and monitoring plans to coordinate delivery and adapt activities as evidence or context changes.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for NGO staff and partner practitioners who assess needs, shape program plans, coordinate delivery or review results. It suits people who need practical links between community input, budgets, workplans and monitoring evidence.
audience: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Officers
prerequisites: Designed for NGO staff or partner practitioners who contribute to needs assessment, program planning, implementation coordination or monitoring. Basic familiarity with NGO activities is useful. No coding or programming is required; the exercises use program documents and planning artefacts.
